message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: In 2014 Oct 14, Zhang forced entry, stripped victim, attempted rape (failed insertion), then performed oral insertion, manual and oral sexual assault, also beat causing rib fractures, resulting in light injury. Also prior incidents 2013 May and July: harassment, indecent exposure (exposing genitals). So crimes: forced rape? In Chinese law, "强奸罪" requires vaginal penetration. Here insertion failed, but oral insertion and manual stimulation constitute "强制猥亵罪" (forced indecency). However also there is assault causing injury: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). The act of forced entry and assault may be considered "强制猥亵罪" plus "故意伤害罪". The prior harassment may be considered "强制猥亵罪" as well, but maybe "猥亵罪" (indecent assault). The main charge likely "强制猥亵罪" (forced indecency) and "故意伤害罪". In examples, they often list two crimes separated by semicolon. So answer: [罪名]强制猥亵罪;故意伤害罪<eoa>. Need format exactly: [罪名]强制猥亵;故意伤害<eoa> maybe they use simplified names like "强制猥亵" and "故意伤害". In examples they wrote "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". They sometimes combine with comma. But format: multiple separated by semicolon. So final: [罪名]强制猥亵;故意伤害<eoa>.
